title: Design: the Fixed Rules tab, read only, with its tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location with a fixed sell price of $12.50.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Fixed Rules tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Point at the info icon beside Fixed Price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The tab lists parts with a fixed price, the new part at $12.50 among them.
  • The columns read Part Number, Description, Category and Fixed Price, the price right-aligned, as in picture 10.12.
  • The tab label shows its count, for example "Fixed Rules (2)", beside "Tiers" and "Matrices" with theirs.
  • No Edit button shows.

Step 2:

  • A tooltip reads "Sells at this price, ahead of any tier price. Set on the part."

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
